}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== ''LuckFox'' logo and "Luckfox Pico Zero" are silkscreened on board top. {{See also|List of SBCs}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RV1106G3 @1.2GHz ARM (Cortex-A7) :NPU: 1 TOPS INT4/INT8/INT16 :VPU: 5M @30fps H.265/H.264 encoding, :16M @60fps JPEG snapshot *Storage: 8GB (eMMC) flash ([[Rayson]]), :TF card (max.256GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 256MB (DDR3L) RAM (integrated SiP) *Wi-Fi: [[AIC]] AIC8800 DC (2.4GHz 1T1R 802.11ax) :AX300; SDIO: Wi-Fi, UART/PCM: BT 5.2 BLE *USB: 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) OTG *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 5V via USB (Type-C) port
